# T-9: Decouple workflow guidance

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Remove workflow-specific flow instructions from generated AI skill text and preserve issue-start behavior through the official workflow plugin prepare.post hook.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R9 acceptance is covered by skill source and generated skill assertions.
- Workflow-specific post-flow board integration text no longer appears in senti.flow skill text.
- plugin.config.workflow.flowIntegration=enable with a linked issue triggers the official workflow plugin prepare.post issue-start-equivalent behavior.
- Unavailable board or gh support remains informational and non-blocking.
- Generated skill artifacts in the diff reflect source changes if skill or preset sources are changed.

## Implementation Notes
Do not migrate the workflow implementation itself. Implement only the hook-ready deterministic entry needed to preserve the existing opt-in issue-start behavior.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local text assertions plus existing skill generation tests; run senti upgrade when required.
